text: RGTI is down 54% with a 74% drawdown from its high, revenue is shrinking by 34%, the company is deeply unprofitable, and insiders are selling — this thesis is broken and the position should be closed to stop further losses.
QBTS is down 43% and sitting 62% below its high — this speculative quantum computing bet has failed and should be sold before more capital is lost.
IONQ is down 34% and 59% off its high with deep losses and no path to profitability in sight — sell this position and redeploy the capital into stronger holdings.
ARCI.L is a large holding down 31% from its high, and given the weak macro backdrop with slowing jobs growth and hawkish Fed, consider trimming this oversized position to reduce concentration risk.
Adobe looks attractively priced at a PE around 8 with solid 10.5% revenue growth and strong free cash flow — this pullback in a proven cash-generating business is worth adding to on weakness.
Google is down about 9% and 21% off its high, and for a company still growing revenue meaningfully, this dip looks like a reasonable opportunity to add at a better price.
ServiceNow is down nearly 14% despite 21% revenue growth and strong free cash flow — this quality compounder at a significant discount from its high is worth adding to gradually.
